_comment: cost-model-bench: OpenIVM's incremental-vs-recompute cost model sweep. Internal.
With feature_flags.cost_model_bench on, an experiment runs the sweep INSTEAD of the
timed 3-batch benchmark, for the same reason compiler-bench does: it creates and
refreshes thousands of views and reads none of the TPC-DI sources, so datagen is
skipped and the timings would not be comparable anyway.
Per case it times the adaptive refresh decision against forced incremental and forced
full, and cross-checks the refreshed view against the base query with EXCEPT ALL in
cost_model_bench.scale_factors is separate from the experiment's own: the subject is
how the decision moves with data volume, so one run covers several TPC-C scale factors.
batch_*_pct are required by the schema but unused.
cost_model_bench.args reaches the binary verbatim, so delta sizes, repetitions, the
query set and flag configurations change here rather than in a workflow file.
The full ladder: every query at scale factors 1 through 100. Hours of runner time.
cost-model-bench.json holds the smoke experiment for checking the plumbing first.
